learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to discover the amazing geography, physical features, and the beautiful diversity of our very own country, India!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: India is a vast country located in the Northern Hemisphere and the continent of Asia. It is surrounded by three big water bodies: the Arabian Sea, the Bay of Bengal, and the Indian Ocean.
In the north, India is guarded by the mighty Himalayas. The word Himalaya means 'the abode of snow'. They protect us from cold winds and are the source of many big rivers like the Ganga.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🌾 The Northern Plains & The Great Desert
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Just below the Himalayas are the flat and fertile Northern Plains where a lot of our food grows. Towards the west lies the dry and sandy Great Indian Desert, also known as the Thar Desert.
The lower half of India looks like a triangle pointing downwards into the ocean. This area is called the Peninsular Plateau. It is uneven, rocky, and full of valuable minerals.

fun_activity.title: 🖍️ Map Master: Color India!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a blank physical map of India. Color the Himalayas brown, the Northern Plains green, the Thar Desert yellow, and the water around India blue. You just mapped Bharat!

quick_recap: ⭐ India, also known as Bharat, is located in the continent of Asia.
⭐ India is surrounded by water on three sides, making its southern part a peninsula.
⭐ Our country has a beautiful mix of mountains, plains, plateaus, and deserts.
